assertions.subject: Pulmonary Atresia with Intact Ventricular Septum
assertions.predicate: abnormal connections between the right ventricle and the epicardial coronary arteries
assertions.quote: The right ventricle develops abnormal connections with the epicardial coronary arteries, which help decompress the ventricle

assertions.subject: Pulmonary Atresia with Intact Ventricular Septum
assertions.predicate: progressive stenosis of the coronary arteries
assertions.quote: Over time, these abnormal connections lead to progressive stenosis of the coronary arteries due to high-velocity blood flow through them

assertions.subject: Pulmonary Atresia with Intact Ventricular Septum
assertions.quote: Due to progressive stenosis of the coronary arteries over time, some parts of the myocardium become dependent on the right ventricle for perfusion, a condition known as RVDCC

assertions.subject: Pulmonary Atresia with Intact Ventricular Septum
